bodyProgress.title: Body progress
bodyProgress.intro: How your composition and your measured circumferences changed against a reference session.

composition.title: Body composition
composition.note: Each axis is scaled against its own reference value, so the outline shows change, not a score. Further out is not better.
composition.rings: The middle ring is the reference measurement; the inner and outer rings mark 10 percent below and above it.
composition.info: Muscle, water, fat and bone are measured separately and overlap: body water is largely held in lean tissue. They therefore do not add up to 100 percent and are not shown as shares of a whole.
composition.chartLabel: Four-axis outline of muscle, water, fat and bone. Each axis is scaled so the reference measurement sits on the middle ring.
composition.hint: Select an axis to see its value, change and source.

shape.title: Body shape
shape.caption: Schematic visualization based on recorded circumferences — not a body scan.
shape.chartLabel: Schematic body outline, current compared with the reference measurement.
shape.hint: Select a body region to see its circumference and change.
shape.measureCaption: Schematic measure figure based on recorded circumferences — not a body scan.
shape.measureChartLabel: Schematic measure figure: a caliper at every measured level, with the reference measurement marked on it.
shape.measureLegendHint: The marks on each caliper show the reference measurement.

panels.title: Body progress display
panels.hint: Choose which drawings and measurements appear on the progress page. Both are on by default. With both off, body progress goes entirely and the page shows only weight and nutrition. Only the display is hidden — your measurements stay recorded and stay in the data export.
panels.compositionHint: The four-axis diagram, plus body fat, muscle mass, body water and bone mass in the history and the table.
panels.shapeHint: The schematic body outline with its change by region, plus the key figures and every circumference in the history and the table.

change.legendHint: Increase is shown filled, decrease hatched. Every value is also written out.

sourceFull.MANUAL: Measured by hand with a tape measure
sourceFull.BIA: Bioelectrical impedance, from a smart scale or body analyser
sourceFull.ESTIMATE: Estimated from a formula, not measured
sourceFull.OPTICAL_SCAN: Estimated from a body scan photo, not measured

kpi.bmiInfo: Body weight divided by height in metres squared.
kpi.whtrInfo: Waist circumference divided by height. A single number that tracks central circumference independently of overall size.
kpi.whrInfo: Waist circumference divided by hip circumference. It describes shape rather than size.
kpi.rfmInfo: Estimated from height, waist circumference and sex. Intended for adults. This is a formula, not a measured body fat percentage.

series.title: Measurements over time
series.subtitle: Several measurements can be shown at once, nutrition included. The reference session is marked on the timeline, and selecting a point makes it the current measurement.
series.hint: Touch or focus a point to show its value and its change from the reference.
series.empty: Not enough data in this range.
series.multiHint: Pick up to four at once. Each measurement gets its own scale: the first two are labelled left and right, the rest state their range in the legend.
series.selectionLimit: Four measurements at a time. Switch another one off first.

table.title: Measurement detail
table.subtitle: Current session compared with the reference session of {date}.

checkin.title: Body check-in
checkin.intro: Enter what you measured. Advanced measurements stay collapsed so a weekly session takes under a minute.

figure.title: Body figure
figure.intro: Choose how the figure is drawn. It is a look, not a finding.
figure.disclaimer: The build you pick only sets the drawing's starting proportions, which your own measurements then adjust. It is never read from your measurements, and it is not used in any calculation on this page.

styleHint.SILHOUETTE: The body outline, with tinted bands over the regions that changed.
styleHint.MEASURE: The figure with its arms out and a caliper at every measured level. The marks on each caliper show where the reference measurement sat.

empty.intro: No body measurements yet. A check-in records what you measured with a tape and, if you have one, what a smart scale reported.
empty.records: Weight goes to your weight log, so the weight chart below stays the single record of it.
empty.needsSecond: This is your first session, so there is nothing to compare it with yet. Record a second check-in to see changes.

capture.pendingReview: A scan is waiting for your review
capture.title: Body scan
capture.intro: Two photos - one from the front, one from the side - are turned into estimated circumferences. The photos are deleted as soon as they have been read.
capture.notAMeasurement: This estimates your measurements from the outline of your body. It is not a measurement and not a medical result. Nothing about body fat, muscle or body water can be read from a photo.

tips.background: Stand against a plain, uncluttered wall in even light.
tips.clothing: Wear close-fitting clothes. Loose clothing is measured instead of you.
tips.framing: Get your whole body in frame, from the top of your head to your feet, with room on both sides.
tips.pose: Stand upright, feet together, arms roughly a hand's width out from your sides, so a strip of the wall shows between each arm and your body. Keep your hands clear of your thighs.
tips.repeat: Use the same spot, distance and clothing every time. Consistency matters more for tracking progress than any single scan.

capture.heightHint: Taken from your profile. It is the only thing that sets the scale, so correct it there if it is wrong.
capture.consent: I agree to these two photos being processed on this server to estimate my measurements.
capture.retention: The photos are stored only until they have been processed, at most ten minutes, and are then deleted. They are never shown again and never sent anywhere else.

review.title: Scan result
review.working: Processing your scan. Your photos are deleted as soon as it finishes.
review.stageQueued: Waiting for a free worker. Nothing has read your photos yet.
review.stageAnalysing: Analysing your photos. They are deleted the moment this finishes.
review.timedOutBody: Nothing picked this scan up in the ten minutes its photos are kept for, so the photos have been deleted and it cannot be processed now. If this keeps happening, the background worker is probably not running.
review.intro: Pick the values you want to keep. Nothing is recorded until you do, and you can correct any value before accepting it.
review.notAMeasurement: These are estimates from the outline of your body, with the range each one could plausibly fall in. Treat a change over several scans as more meaningful than any single number.
review.tableCaption: Estimated circumferences, with the range and your current recorded value
review.willWrite: The values you ticked will be saved to this day's check-in. Anything you left unticked is discarded.
review.willDiscard: Nothing is ticked, so this scan will be discarded without recording anything.
review.done: This scan has already been reviewed.
review.alreadyReviewed: This scan has already been reviewed.
review.pairedNote: A photo cannot tell your left side from your right, so a thigh or calf estimate is recorded for both sides. Upper arms are not estimated: a front view crosses the arms and the torso at once, and nothing in an outline says where one stops - measure those by tape.
review.processor: Estimated by {provider} {model}, version {version}. Recorded with the result, so a later version can be told apart on your charts.
review.rejected: The scan could not be used
review.rejectedIntro: Nothing was estimated, because the photos could not be read reliably:
review.partialIntro: Everything below was measured. These levels were not, and the scan says why rather than guessing at them:
review.failedBody: Something went wrong while processing the photos. They have been deleted; please try again.
review.expiredBody: The photos were not processed in time and have been deleted. Please try again.

quality.front-empty: Nothing could be told apart from the background in the front view.
quality.side-empty: Nothing could be told apart from the background in the side view.
quality.cut-off-top: The top of your head is outside the frame.
quality.cut-off-bottom: Your feet are outside the frame.
quality.too-small: You are too far away. Fill more of the frame.
quality.off-centre: You are touching the edge of the frame. Step towards the middle.
quality.background-busy: Your outline could not be separated from the background. Use a plainer wall and more even light.
quality.height-mismatch: The two photos were taken from different distances. Use the same spot for both.
quality.arms-touching: Your arms are flat against your body, so there is no telling where your torso ends and an arm begins. Stand with your arms roughly a hand's width out from your sides, so a strip of the wall shows between each arm and your body, and take both photos again.
quality.arm-obscured-neck: Your neck could not be measured, because an arm crossed that height. Everything else was measured.
quality.arm-obscured-chest: Your chest could not be measured: your upper arm was still resting against it, and a photo cannot tell the two apart. Everything else was measured. Hold your arms a little further out to include it next time.
quality.arm-obscured-waist: Your waist could not be measured: an arm was against your side at that height. Everything else was measured. Hold your arms a little further out to include it next time.
quality.arm-obscured-hip: Your hips could not be measured: a hand or forearm was resting against them. Everything else was measured. Hold your arms a little further out to include them next time.
quality.arm-obscured-thigh: Your thighs could not be measured: a hand was hanging beside them, and an outline cannot tell a hand from a leg. Everything else was measured. Hold your arms a little further out, clear of your legs, to include them next time.
quality.arm-obscured-calf: Your calves could not be measured, because an arm crossed that height. Everything else was measured.

dataSources.title: Data sources
dataSources.subtitle: Where NutriCore's nutrition data comes from, and under what terms.
dataSources.offBody: Primary source for packaged foods. The Open Food Facts database is made available under the Open Database License (ODbL); individual contents are under the Database Contents License. Product images carry their own licence terms. Cached records keep their provider id and retrieval time so they stay identifiable as OFF-derived.
dataSources.usdaBody: Optional source for generic ingredients and staple foods. USDA FoodData Central data is generally in the public domain (CC0), and is attributed here regardless.
dataSources.ownBody: Foods you create are marked as your own. AI suggestions are estimates, are calculated from resolved ingredients rather than invented totals, and are only stored after you confirm them.
dataSources.shareAlike: Redistributing a database derived from Open Food Facts may carry share-alike obligations under the ODbL. This page is operational documentation, not legal advice.
dataSources.compendiumBody: The activity library’s MET values come from the 2024 Adult Compendium. Compendium codes are retained for auditability.

hint.MODEL_TIMEOUT: The model did not answer in time. Usually a model that is too slow, a prompt that is too long, or an answer that never terminates.
hint.MODEL_UNREACHABLE: The connection to Ollama was never established. Check AI_BASE_URL and whether the worker container can reach the Ollama network.
hint.MODEL_MISSING: The configured model is not present on this Ollama instance. Pull it on the Ollama host with `ollama pull`.
hint.MODEL_HTTP_ERROR: Ollama answered with an error status. Its own log names the reason - most often not enough memory for the model.
hint.MODEL_OUTPUT_INVALID: The answer was JSON but did not match the expected schema. The field paths above name the rejected values.
hint.SOURCE_TOO_LARGE: The page is larger than the 512 KB limit. Another attempt cannot change that.
hint.SOURCE_BLOCKED: The address was refused for safety: a private network, a disallowed port, or a disallowed scheme.
hint.SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: The page could not be retrieved - a redirect limit, a timeout, or an error status.
hint.SEARCH_UNAVAILABLE: SearXNG was unreachable or did not answer with JSON. Without source discovery no nutrition source can be found.
hint.RATE_LIMITED: NutriCore's own rate limit stopped the job. Run it again later.
hint.DATA_MISSING: A record the job needs is gone, such as a deleted recipe or food. Another attempt will not help.
hint.UNKNOWN: Not classified. The full cause chain is under “Show details”.
hint.MODEL_OUTPUT_TRUNCATED: The model was stopped at the token limit before it finished. Either the schema permits an answer that is too long, or OLLAMA_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS is too low.
hint.CONFIG_INVALID: A required setting is missing or invalid — the message names it. Check the .env of the affected container; the app and the worker need the same configuration. Another attempt will not help.
hint.MODEL_VISION_UNSUPPORTED: The configured model cannot read images. Choose a vision model or submit text or a URL.
